channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: Polling vs webhooks: how should a trading bot refresh token risk?
item.description: For token risk updates in a trading bot, use events to trigger a fetch, then refresh the report before each order. Poll only a small watchlist to save calls.

item.title: How Do You Calculate Net DEX Swap Output Tokens?
item.description: To calculate the net amount received from a DEX swap, total output-token transfers into your wallet and subtract same-token transfers out; record gas separately.

item.title: Blind Signing vs Clear Signing: What the Prompt Shows
item.description: Blind signing vs clear signing comes down to what your wallet displays: raw data or readable transaction fields you can review before approval on screen.

item.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete digital gold trades
item.description: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX tested digital claims on London gold bars, settling trades and using the interests as collateral in a first for wholesale markets.

item.title: Why One SyncSwap Swap Creates Multiple Transfer Rows
item.description: Why does my swap show several token transfers on the explorer? Each row logs a step; filter for your address to find the trade’s net input and output.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russia-linked crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission has proposed new Russia sanctions covering crypto networks and 60 banks, with approval still needed from all 27 EU states.

item.title: Can anyone submit Bitcoin headers to a bridge relay?
item.description: Can anyone run a relayer for a Bitcoin bridge? Yes, when the relay contract checks proof of work and chain links; the main cost is destination-chain gas.

item.title: Circulating supply vs total supply: What each figure means
item.description: Circulating supply vs total supply in crypto: total counts minted tokens minus burns; circulating counts the share available to trade, leaving locked tokens out.

item.title: Small Token Balance? How to Judge a KyberSwap Swap
item.description: What is the minimum swap amount on KyberSwap? There is no universal floor: route availability, token precision, network gas and approval costs shape what is practical.

item.title: OKXICE opens 24/7 tokenized securities venue to US users
item.description: OKXICE opened its round-the-clock securities venue to eligible US customers, with 113 stocks, ETFs and ETPs set for phased rollout in the OKX app.

item.title: Does Fraxswap Only Trade Frax Tokens? Find the Right DEX
item.description: Fraxswap can trade beyond Frax tokens when an ERC-20 pair exists and has liquidity; the Fraxswap Factory lets anyone create such a pair. Use Fraxswap for…

item.title: Polygon bridge: why deposits sync and withdrawals need proof?
item.description: Polygon bridge state sync vs checkpoint explained: Ethereum deposits arrive through validator relays; Polygon withdrawals need a checkpoint and a claim.

item.title: Slippage Tolerance: Set a Safer Swap Floor
item.description: How to set slippage tolerance to reduce sandwich attack risk: choose a narrow floor that allows ordinary quote movement while limiting how far a swap can worsen before it reverts.

item.title: Token custody during a routed DEX swap
item.description: Who holds your crypto during a DEX swap? Your tokens stay in your wallet before and after; smart contracts move them through the route in one transaction.

item.title: How does a Solana rug pull drain a liquidity pool?
item.description: How do rug pulls work on Solana? A creator keeps control of liquidity or token permissions, draws in buyers, then drains SOL, mints supply or blocks sellers.

item.title: Polygon Publishes Heimdall v0.14.0 After Purley Goes Live
item.description: Polygon has made Heimdall v0.14.0 public after Purley activated on mainnet and Amoy, adding new checks for validator votes, bridge events, staking updates and checkpoints.

item.title: Which bridge model fits: multisig, validator set or light client?
item.description: Multisig vs light client vs validator bridges: light clients suit large transfers; validator sets or multisigs trade stronger trust for speed and coverage.

item.title: Hong Kong bill would bring four crypto services under SFC rules
item.description: Hong Kong has gazetted a bill to bring crypto dealing, advice, management and custody under SFC oversight, with lawmakers set to consider it on Dec. 2.

item.title: MetaMask Mobile vs Trust Wallet: choose the right DEX wallet
item.description: MetaMask Mobile vs Trust Wallet for DEX trading: choose MetaMask for EVM trades and desktop pairing, or Trust Wallet for holding assets across many chains.

item.title: MetaMask users: replace a shared RPC with your own key
item.description: How do I add my own RPC URL with an API key to MetaMask? Add your provider’s chain-specific HTTPS endpoint, make it the default and check provider activity.
